cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Who Changed It?
cards.instruction: Ask innocent questions until someone admits altering the plan, schedule, arrangement, or shared space.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. I can't open the cupboard. Was the sofa this close yesterday?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: There's more room for yoga now.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. Did making that room involve moving the sofa?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Yes, I moved it. I put the things you'll need somewhere easier.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: How thoughtful. Would those be the mugs in your sock drawer, or has someone else improved the kitchen too?

mechanism: A copies a changed room's apparent ritual while using gentle questions to identify who rearranged it.
confusable: S04 misinterprets the confident pose; D40 seeks the responsible changer rather than general complaint.
comparison: Room use and object relocation versus calendar edit.
seedUse: D40-b first admission leads a question tying other displaced objects to the same person.
